procedures.title: Athena service mode: Display fail message decode

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator or disconnect power before servicing. For live voltage checks, use proper PPE and disconnect power after measurements.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Enter Athena service mode
steps.body: Within 30 s of power-up, set TEMP to minimum. Hold door switch closed and press RC TEMP 5 s. Advance with SW1 (3 s between presses) to step 6.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Within 30 s of power-up, set TEMP to minimum. Hold door switch closed and press RC TEMP 5 s. Advance with SW1 (3 s between presses) to step 6.

steps.title: Fail LED pattern at step 6
steps.body: Which fail pattern is displayed? (D9/D8/D7/D6) All blank = drivers and sensors OK. D6 only = main board driver; D7 = RC sensor; D8 = defrost sensor; D7+D8 = both sensors; D6+D7 or D6+D8 = board + sensor; all on = multiple failures.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Which fail pattern is displayed? (D9/D8/D7/D6) All blank = drivers and sensors OK. D6 only = main board driver; D7 = RC sensor; D8 = defrost sensor; D7+D8 = both sensors; D6+D7 or D6+D8 = board + sensor; all on = multiple failures.

steps.title: RC sensor follow-up
steps.body: Run w11296289-test-03-rc-thermistor or measure ATHENA J2-3 ↔ J2-4 — 2.7 kΩ @ 25°C.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Run w11296289-test-03-rc-thermistor or measure ATHENA J2-3 ↔ J2-4 — 2.7 kΩ @ 25°C.

steps.title: Defrost sensor follow-up
steps.body: Run w11296289-test-05-defrost-thermistor or measure evaporator thermistor circuit.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Run w11296289-test-05-defrost-thermistor or measure evaporator thermistor circuit.

steps.title: Main board driver fault
steps.body: Verify heater and compressor outputs at JP1 before replacing ATHENA control.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify heater and compressor outputs at JP1 before replacing ATHENA control.

steps.title: Multiple failures
steps.body: Address sensor faults first, then retest step 6. Replace board if sensors verified good.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Address sensor faults first, then retest step 6. Replace board if sensors verified good.

steps.title: Navigate to service step 1

steps.sourceExcerpt: Service step 1 — FC

steps.title: Read sensor LED feedback
steps.body: At step 1, board reads FC thermistor. Refrigeration TEMP LEDs: Open = LED6+7 on; Short = LED8 on; Pass = LED6–8 on; Blank = awaiting valid reading.
steps.sourceExcerpt: At step 1, board reads FC thermistor. Refrigeration TEMP LEDs: Open = LED6+7 on; Short = LED8 on; Pass = LED6–8 on; Blank = awaiting valid reading.

steps.body: What does the refrigeration TEMP LED pattern show?
steps.sourceExcerpt: What does the refrigeration TEMP LED pattern show?

steps.body: THESEUS P5 P5-3 ↔ P5-4 or ATHENA J2 J2-1 ↔ J2-2 — 2.7 kΩ @ 25°C (5 VDC input circuit).

steps.title: Compressor and condenser fan run

branches.label: No / fault

steps.body: Toggle load OFF with RC TEMP key before leaving step.

steps.body: Unplug unit. Access compressor terminals and fan motors.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug unit. Access compressor terminals and fan motors.

steps.title: Compressor run windings
steps.body: EGX60HLC / EM3Y60HLP run windings 1–5 Ω.
steps.sourceExcerpt: EGX60HLC / EM3Y60HLP run windings 1–5 Ω.

steps.title: Condenser fan motor
steps.body: Condenser fan motor 3–12 Ω.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Condenser fan motor 3–12 Ω.

steps.title: Optional: compressor voltage
steps.body: Restore power at step 7. THESEUS P1-2 ↔ P1-4 or ATHENA JP1-4 ↔ JP1-6 — 120 VAC when cooling.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Restore power at step 7. THESEUS P1-2 ↔ P1-4 or ATHENA JP1-4 ↔ JP1-6 — 120 VAC when cooling.

steps.sourceExcerpt: 120 VAC at compressor output when load commanded.

steps.title: Read tray thermistor

steps.title: Tray thermistor LED result
steps.body: Open = LED6+7; Short = LED8; Pass = LED6–8. Models without twist tray read open.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Open = LED6+7; Short = LED8; Pass = LED6–8. Models without twist tray read open.

steps.title: Bench tray thermistor
steps.body: Disconnect power. Measure ice maker tray thermistor — 2.7 kΩ @ 25°C if equipped.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power. Measure ice maker tray thermistor — 2.7 kΩ @ 25°C if equipped.

steps.title: Tray thermistor resistance
steps.body: 2.7 kΩ @ 25°C at ice maker harness.
steps.sourceExcerpt: 2.7 kΩ @ 25°C at ice maker harness.
